function.name: code_run
function.description: Code executor. Prefer python. Multi-call OK, use script param. Reply code block is executed if no script arg; prefer for single call to avoid escaping. No hardcoding bulk data

script.description: [Mutually exclusive] NEVER use this param when use reply code block.

inline_eval.description: DO NOT USE except explicitly specified.

function.name: file_read
function.description: Read file. Read before modify for latest context and line numbers

keyword.description: [Optional] If provided, returns first match (case-insensitive) with context

function.name: file_patch
function.description: Replace unique old_content with new_content. Exact match required (whitespace/indentation). On failure, file_read to recheck

old_content.description: Original text block to replace (must be unique)

new_content.description: New content. Supports {{file:path:startLine:endLine}} to ref file lines, auto-expanded

function.name: file_write
function.description: Create/overwrite/append files. HUGE edits ONLY. Supports {{file:path:startLine:endLine}}, auto-expanded

function.name: web_scan
function.description: Get simplified HTML and tab list. Removes hidden/floating/covered elements. Call after switching pages

tabs_only.description: Show tab list only, no HTML

function.name: web_execute_js
function.description: Execute JavaScript in the real Chrome page as a peer low-level browser-control tool for probing, framework state inspection, complex DOM reads, CDP/special operations, and actions that indexed browser tools cannot represent safely. It is not above or below browser_* tools; choose by task shape. Multi-call OK with different switch_tab_id. Use no_monitor only for read-only probing. Execute JS in ```javascript blocks if no script arg, to avoid escaping

script.description: [Mutually exclusive] JS code or script path. NEVER use this param when use reply code block

no_monitor.description: Skip page change monitoring, saves 2-3s. Only for reads, not for page actions

switch_tab_id.description: [Optional] Tab ID to switch to before executing

function.name: browser_use_index
function.description: Get a structured indexed snapshot from the real Chrome page for recoverable element targeting, including dynamic page signals, same-origin iframe/frame summaries, scan_anchor navigation fields, field context, and field/control/layer context. This is not full-page extraction and not complex DOM reasoning. Use before browser_action when indexes may have changed.

switch_tab_id.description: [Optional] Tab ID to switch to before reading state

include_invisible.description: Include invisible elements in visible frame chains; hidden parent iframe subtrees are never exposed

function.name: browser_find
function.description: Read-only semantic locator used after browser_use_index to find indexed browser elements from the latest structured snapshot of the real Chrome page. Provide query or table as the real semantic locator; role/layer/control_kind/frame_path are optional filters and are not sufficient by themselves. Best for same-origin iframe forms, field labels, table cells, and visible overlay content already present in browser_use_index. If the page changed or the snapshot was truncated, refresh browser_use_index before repeating the same query. It scores visible text, labels, field labels, table context, and field ids/names. This is not a global search engine and not a browser_use_index replacement. Returns candidate indexes with score, reason, and ambiguity instead of acting.

control_kind.description: Optional control kind hard filter such as contenteditable, native_input, custom_select

layer.description: Optional layer filter such as main, modal, drawer, popover

table.description: Optional table locator with row_text and column_text

include_invisible.description: Include invisible elements while refreshing state

switch_tab_id.description: [Optional] Tab ID to switch to before finding

function.name: browser_recipe
function.description: Run fixed deterministic high-level browser recipes for structured component flows in the real Chrome page: custom_select, layer_select, table_locate, and component_wait. Recipes require bounded arguments and fail closed on ambiguity. Recipes are not a general planner. Use them for dropdown, modal picker, or bounded overlay flows that need more than one browser_action step rather than blind repeated browser_action.

target.description: Target locator. custom_select/layer_select require index or query; component_wait accepts query targets only.

option_text.description: Option text for custom_select or layer_select

confirm_text.description: Explicit confirm button text for layer_select

table.description: Table locator such as row_text and column_text for table_locate

switch_tab_id.description: [Optional] Tab ID to switch to before running recipe

function.name: browser_action
function.description: Perform bounded indexed browser actions against latest browser_use_index elements in the real Chrome page; this is not arbitrary selector automation or a form planner. Native select stays native select; custom dropdowns are not select. For submit/search after input, call keys with text Enter and omit index to use the focused element. SPA wait actions include wait_dom_stable, wait_not_busy, wait_route, and indexed wait_enabled. Verification fields verify/verify_text/verify_value/verify_selector are supported for click/input/select/keys only; wait actions reject verify. Failed verification returns stage verify_failed. Failures include structured recovery suggestions when a safer next browser_* step is available. selector is supported for wait_selector and as a custom busy selector for wait_not_busy.

action.description: Browser action to perform, including bounded SPA stability waits

index.description: Indexed element id from browser_use_index. For keys after input, omit index so the key is sent to the focused element.

text.description: Text for input, keys, wait_text, or matching

value.description: Value for select or input actions

selector.description: CSS selector for wait_selector, or custom busy selector for wait_not_busy

verify.description: Verification type for click/input/select/keys only. Wait actions reject verify. Failed verification returns status failed with stage verify_failed.

verify_text.description: Expected text for text or element_text verification

verify_value.description: Non-empty expected value for field_value verification

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for wait actions

switch_tab_id.description: [Optional] Tab ID to switch to before acting

function.name: update_working_checkpoint
function.description:
Short-term working notepad, auto-injected each turn to prevent info loss in long tasks. Call during early/mid stages, not at end. When: (1) after reading SOP, store user needs & key constraints (skip for simple 1-2 step tasks); (2) before subtask switch or context flush; (3) after repeated failures, re-read SOP and must store new findings; (4) on new task, update content, clear old progress but keep valid constraints.

Don't call: simple tasks (1-2 steps), task completed (use long-term memory tool)

key_info.description: Replaces current notepad (<200 tokens). Incremental update: review existing, keep valid, add/remove/modify. Store: pitfalls, user requirements, key params/findings, file paths, progress, next steps. Don't store: ephemeral info, obvious context, old task info when user switched tasks. Prefer over-updating over losing key info

related_sop.description: Related SOP names, tips for further re-read

function.name: ask_user
function.description: Interrupt task to ask user when needing decisions, extra info, or facing unresolvable blockers

candidates.description: Optional quick-select choices for the user

function.name: start_long_term_update
function.description: Start distilling long-term memory. Call when discovering info worth remembering (env facts/user prefs/lessons learned). Skip if memory already updated or in autonomous flow. Must call when a task that took 15+ turns is completed
